categories.drinking_cup: A vessel explicitly intended for drinking beverages.
categories.measuring_cup: A vessel or scoop explicitly intended to measure a quantity of material.
categories.desk_organizer: An item explicitly intended to arrange desktop supplies.
categories.cup_holder: An accessory that supports a separate drinking cup; not itself a drinking vessel.
categories.decorative_vessel: A vessel explicitly intended for decorative display.
categories.lighting: An item explicitly intended to provide illumination.
categories.gardening_kit: A kit explicitly intended for gardening or growing plants.
categories.cable_accessory: An accessory for cables; its intended use still requires specific evidence.
categories.storage_container: A container explicitly intended to store objects or materials.
categories.unknown: The listing does not establish a supported category, or explicit claims conflict.

uses.measure_materials: Measure a quantity of material using the product.
uses.display_decoration: Display the product or decorative contents as decoration.
uses.gardening: Use the supplied kit for growing or tending plants.
uses.unknown: No supported primary use can be established, or explicit claims conflict.

rules: Use only exact labels from this versioned taxonomy.
Use unknown for an unsupported category or primary use and an empty list for unsupported secondary uses.
Each asserted category and use requires an exact excerpt from name, description, or supplier_notes.
An excerpt match verifies provenance only; it does not establish semantic correctness.
Distinguish vessels from accessories that hold separate vessels.
Use only explicit intended uses; do not infer arbitrary repurposing or food, heat, or medical suitability.
Abstain on mutually exclusive conflicting claims unless the listing explicitly establishes genuine multiple functions.
Do not duplicate the primary use in secondary_uses; include distinct explicit secondary functions.
